WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (
            SELECT
                c.id,
                c.topic_id,
                c.parent_id,
                c.body,
                c.created_at,
                c.edited_at,
                c.deleted_at,
                c.author_id,
                0 AS depth,
                ARRAY[c.id] AS path
            FROM community_topic_comment c
            WHERE c.topic_id = $1
              AND c.parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2::uuid
              AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR c.id > $3::uuid)
            ORDER BY c.id
            LIMIT $4
        ),
        comment_tree AS (
            SELECT * FROM roots
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                c.id,
                c.topic_id,
                c.parent_id,
                c.body,
                c.created_at,
                c.edited_at,
                c.deleted_at,
                c.author_id,
                ct.depth + 1,
                ct.path || c.id
            FROM community_topic_comment c
            INNER JOIN comment_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id
            WHERE ct.depth < $5
        )
        SELECT
            ct.id AS "id!",
            ct.topic_id AS "topic_id!",
            ct.parent_id,
            ct.depth AS "depth!",
            ct.body AS "body!",
            ct.created_at AS "created_at!",
            ct.edited_at,
            ct.deleted_at,
            up.user_id AS author_id,
            up.slug AS author_slug,
            up.name AS author_name,
            up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url,
            up.status AS author_status
        FROM comment_tree ct
        INNER JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = ct.author_id
        ORDER BY ct.path
